name: Forest Hawk
reviewKind: second independent full visual review of the private v4 candidate
scope: Private candidate only. No production model, atlas, receipt, or tracker was changed.

independentVisualVerdict.finding: No visible face, scarf/neck, body, or limb distortion or separation across the personally inspected exact-hash evidence. The dark neck wrap remains continuous under the beak and around the neck as the head pitches and the body leans. Death and recovery poses remain a connected bird; changes read as pose rotation and compression rather than mesh shear.
independentVisualVerdict.specificTarget: The attack, recovery, and opposing-side views retain a stable face-to-neck connection. The scarf silhouette changes with head/body pitch but does not detach, balloon, or pull the torso out of alignment. Feet and legs stay attached to the body in front and side views.
independentVisualVerdict.atlasFinding: The newly generated 4x4 production impostor atlas is bound to the exact candidate battle hash. All 16 cells were inspected; no detached scarf, isolated limb/foot fragment, or obvious silhouette break was visible. The older atlas was not used for this verdict.

rawSourceAndBattle.scope: All 13 authored clips at phases 0, 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875, and 1; front, side, head-front, head-side, and opposing-side head views for each model stage.

runtimeLow.scope: All 16 production transition rows, six phases, front/side head and body views, source and battle candidate bytes.

runtimeMedium.scope: All 16 production transition rows, six phases, front/side head and body views, source and battle candidate bytes.

productionCompanionIdleAndTechniques.scope: Production PetYardModelStage with exact private battle bytes injected; 24 consecutive idle frames at 30 fps and all nine equipped techniques sampled at 12 timestamps in front and side views (216 technique samples).

limits: PASS applies to this exact private candidate pair and newly generated atlas. It does not mean the candidate is live or promoted.
Numeric evidence and another reviewer's report are not substitutes for this verdict; the stated disposition follows my own inspection of the listed sheets and all atlas cells.
